array.string: cd __ROOT__ || { /usr/bin/osascript -e 'display notification "The book agent cannot reach its folder" with title "Trading bot alert"'; exit 1; }; RUN_LABEL=book SYMBOLS=@book EXECUTION=alpaca-paper TSMOM_STATE=on LONG_ONLY=on STRATEGY=tsmom INTERVAL=1d TSMOM_LOOKBACK=28 TSMOM_LOOKBACKS=7,14,28,56 TSMOM_ENTER_VOTES=3 TSMOM_EXIT_VOTES=1 EVAL_HORIZON=28 FEE_BPS=30 BUDGET=100000 PER_TRADE_USD=2000 MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS=50 ENTRY_WINDOW_MIN=120 LIMIT_SLIPPAGE_BPS=30 ENTRY_SKIP=@book-stocks __NPM__ run scan >> __DATA__/tsmom-scan.log 2>&1; rc=$?; RUN_LABEL=watch-flip EXECUTION=sim TSMOM_STATE=off SYMBOLS=ETHUSDT,BNBUSDT,ADAUSDT,LINKUSDT LONG_ONLY=on STRATEGY=tsmom INTERVAL=1d TSMOM_LOOKBACK=28 EVAL_HORIZON=28 FEE_BPS=30 __NPM__ run scan >> __DATA__/tsmom-scan.log 2>&1; RUN_LABEL=watch-sol EXECUTION=sim TSMOM_STATE=off SYMBOLS=SOLUSDT LONG_ONLY=off STRATEGY=tsmom INTERVAL=1d TSMOM_LOOKBACK=28 EVAL_HORIZON=28 FEE_BPS=30 __NPM__ run scan >> __DATA__/tsmom-scan.log 2>&1; exit $rc
